topics.title: Appendix A — CUDA and Heterogeneous-Computing Diagnostic Desk Reference
topics.summary: When an optimized path fails, reduce uncertainty in a fixed order. Validate dimensions and configuration before allocating resources. Check every host API result. Check kernel launch status. Establish asynchronous completion at a deliberate boundary. Compare the smallest deterministic input against the CPU reference. Inspect indexing, byte counts, copy direction, and ownership. Only after correctness is localized should profiling guide optimization.

blocks.text: A useful mismatch report contains the first failing index, expected value, observed value, absolute error, relative error where meaningful, input dimensions, and implementation configuration. Avoid dumping entire production arrays merely because a comparison failed. Diagnostics should preserve evidence without becoming a new performance or storage problem.

blocks.text: For latency regressions, decompose the interval into preparation, host-to-device movement, queue delay, device execution, device-to-host movement, CPU post-processing, and delivery. Not every application contains every stage, but every end-to-end claim needs an explicit start and stop boundary.
